title: Credit Stimulus, Executive Ownership, and Firm Leverage
authors: Rajdeep Chakraborti; Sandeep Dahiya; Lei Ge; Pedro Gete
main_or_robustness: main (continuous-exposure DiD around the 2009 Chinese stimulus)

ineligible_specs.reported_location: Tables 2 and 5-7 (book/market leverage on executive ownership x Credit Push/post2009)
ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: single common date (post2009 for all firms); continuous treatment intensity (per_execuStock, top25_share) or ownership-quartile dummies; time-varying firm controls ($x_list)

ineligible_specs.reported_location: Tables 3-4 (ownership quartile dummies x Credit Push)
ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: time-invariant 2008 ownership quartiles x common post date; controls
continuous exposure x year around one common date; controls

eligible_reason: Not staggered. The shock is China's 2009 credit stimulus, common to all firms (post2009). Treatment intensity is continuous executive stock ownership (or its quartiles/top-25 share), and every column includes time-varying firm controls; some add industry-by-year FE. No binary staggered adoption.
